name: Firma 001 — Demo Market seçilip ana kabuğa girilir
description: retailex_demo üzerinde admin girişi sonrası Demo Market (001) seçilir ve ana uygulama kabuğu açılır.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the RetailEX login page
Connect tenant retailex_demo if the tenant step is shown
Sign in with username admin and password admin
On the firm selection step, open the firm picker and choose Demo Market (CODE 001)
Select an available store if prompted, then submit system login to enter the app
Verify the main app shell loads (top module bar or dashboard) and the selected firm context reflects Demo Market or 001, without remaining on the login form
